TagsInputRoot.description: Holds the tags and the input's text and shares them with the parts inside it. It also renders a visually hidden polite live region that announces a highlighted or removed tag, and, with a `name` (or inside a named FieldRoot), one hidden `<input>` per tag for the form.

props.value: The tags. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control them. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.
props.defaultValue: The tags at first, when they aren't controlled. A form reset puts them back.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new tags whenever one is added or removed, or all are cleared. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the tags and the input are never held by it.
props.inputValue: The input's text. Pass it with `onInputValueChange` to control it.
props.onInputValueChange: Called with the input's text as it is typed, and with what is left once an entry is added (usually an empty string).
props.max: The most tags there may be. An entry past it is refused with the reason `max`.
props.allowDuplicates: Whether the same text may be a tag twice. Otherwise a repeat is refused with the reason `duplicate`.
props.delimiter: Text that finishes an entry when typed or pasted, as Enter does. `null` for none, so only Enter (and `addOnBlur`, `addOnPaste`) adds.
props.addOnBlur: Add what was typed when the input loses focus.
props.addOnPaste: Add everything pasted at once, split at the delimiter and at line breaks, the last part included. Without it a paste is like typing: the parts before a delimiter are added and the rest stays in the input.
props.validate: Whether an entry may be a tag. Entries are trimmed first; one it returns false for is refused with the reason `invalid`. It is called synchronously, so it must be a plain function, not an action.
props.onValueInvalid: Called for each refused entry with `{ value, reason }`, where `reason` is `duplicate`, `max` or `invalid`. The refused text stays in the input to be corrected.
props.disabled: Whether the tags input can't be used or focused. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot. Disabled while its input has focus (`disabled={pending? saved}`), the input takes focus back when it is enabled again.
props.readOnly: Whether the tags can be read and highlighted but not added or removed.
props.required: Whether at least one tag is needed for the form to be valid. The input is natively `required` while there is no tag, so text typed but not yet added counts as filled and the form submits without it.
props.name: The name each tag is submitted under, one entry per tag. Taken from an enclosing FieldRoot when not given.
props.messages: What the live region says: `highlighted(value)`, `removed(value)` and `cleared`. Defaults: "<value>, press Backspace or Delete to remove" (only the value when read-only), "<value> removed" and "All tags removed".

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the tags input is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the tags input is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when the tags input is required.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the input has been focused and left.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the tags have changed.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
dataAttributes.data-invalid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.
dataAttributes.data-filled: Inside a FieldRoot: present when there is at least one tag.
dataAttributes.data-focused: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the input has focus.

TagsInputControl.description: The box that holds the tags and the input. A press on its empty space puts the caret in the input.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the tags input is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the tags input is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when the tags input is required.

TagsInputTag.description: One tag. Render one per entry of the `tagsInput` context's `tags`. A press on it highlights it and keeps the caret in the input. It is never focused itself: focus stays in the input.

props.index: The tag's position in the value: `tag.index` for each `tag` of the context's `tags`.

dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the tag is highlighted: Backspace or Delete removes it.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the tags input is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the tags input is read-only.

TagsInputTagText.description: The tag's text: its value, unless given children.

dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while its tag is highlighted.

TagsInputTagRemove.description: A button that removes its tag. Named "Remove <value>" unless given an `aria-label`. It is not in the tab order (Backspace and Delete remove a highlighted tag), and pressing it leaves focus in the input. Disabled while the tags input is disabled or read-only.

TagsInputInput.description: The text input. Enter or the delimiter adds what was typed; Backspace or ArrowLeft at the start of the text highlights the last tag. Inside a FieldRoot it is the field's control: labelled by FieldLabel and described by FieldDescription and FieldError.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the tags input is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the tags input is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when the tags input is required.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the input has been focused and left.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the tags have changed.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
dataAttributes.data-invalid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.
dataAttributes.data-filled: Inside a FieldRoot: present when there is at least one tag.
dataAttributes.data-focused: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the input has focus.

TagsInputClear.description: A button that removes every tag and the typed text, then puts the caret in the input. Not in the tab order, like the remove buttons. Give it an `aria-label` when its content is an icon.

props.keepMounted: Render the button even when there is nothing to clear.
